reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: createGeneration is a live route handler (src/index.ts:75) with non-test callers. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions map in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; entry point is authenticated REST API, gate does not fire. Gate 3: src/api/generation.ts is explicitly in-scope. Spec deviation is confirmed — no rollback or compensating deletion of the Discord role occurs on DB insert failure (generation.ts L57-64), violating the atomicity post-condition. However, the attack path requires a DB failure condition (transient network error, timeout, or race) that is only partially attacker-controlled, so exploitability is uncertain. Severity retained at Medium: impact is Discord/DB desync and orphaned role accumulation, contained to Discord state corruption with no direct privilege escalation.
